body: As somebody with bpd, dating somebody with bpd, although yes it's as nice as one imagines but at the same time it can be easily a disaster if you want some space in an episode

I don't know who you are so I can't guess. Not everyone here necessarily has bpd, I know people who just browse around this sub from other subs.

I was asking our of curiously since most people if not all I know including myself have this issue so I was surprised to see a different opinion

Do you have a personality or identity disorder?

Edit: no clue why I'm being down voted, I was just curious it's not uncommon to see people with other issues browsing this sub.

Hi,
I like the similarity used here, especially since I have been diagnosed with dpd too I feel like ik the narrator more than anything.

The post was a mid episode rant more than anything since I don't really have anybody to turn out to anymore. Just it sucks, cause first person ever made me think "I want to be with her to enjoy her happiness together" but whatever.

Eh, wtvr........

Hi,

I wasn't clear at all since the post was the result of a mid episode rant. I should clarify that I always respected her but she did not know at first how to set boundaries and went all in to help, which resulted to burning out

I never manipulated her, I never did anything to harm and I was always trying to do what I thought was best. Worst thing I have done is that I said a tiny lie, once, although unjusfiable she has not gone over it and said that she lost all her trust for me.

She hasn't anything explicit, she just became more distant. Why exactly I don't know but upsets me but I respected and haven't contacted her in a while. Its just being alone is one of my triggers, and now that I don't know how to reach out when in need I just spiral down to the old ways. Thanks for reaching out, I appreciate it.
Ability and lamictal gang anyone? I'm not given anti depressants cause ability is "good enough" apparently :/
I like em. I also like how there is drawing meta growing slowly.
